explicit_open_questions: Independent authority for the actual stored/prognostic NN/NC number basis across initialization, boundaries, restart, and transport remains unresolved.
A two-density pair is not an independent proof that a density conversion is physically required or correct.
The CF snapshot is before the in-cloud transformation; activation uses restored grid-mean condensate. No universal claim about all process inputs follows.
Existing saved cases do not jointly show strictly partial CF, 0<activation_fraction<1, and inactive number/water floors/caps at one identified source call.

minimal_next_fixture.design: One bounded same-source actual-module paired run, two EOS-consistent dry-density states, one registered cell/level and actual call key; retain a same-step source-order trace across CF capture, divide, restore, activation, and returned radius helper. Reuse existing fractional-CF and positive-activation observation interfaces where their fields suffice; add only the missing stage/call identity or branch-state fields as a diagnostic observer, not production arithmetic.
minimal_next_fixture.pass_scope: Only demonstrates that these selected, EOS-consistent states traverse the observed code path and that source-ordered updates/branch predicates are internally reproducible. It does not close producer-unit authority, restart/boundary/transport population basis, PSD/LUT metric, or physical accuracy.
required_observations: actual option37 invocation and call identity; QV/ QC/ QI/ QNN/ QNC / P / T / dry DEN at entry, plus initialization provenance
pre-CF condensate values, captured CF and its timestep/top identity
whether CF in-cloud divide and grid-mean restore loops cover the selected level; activation-site restored QV/QC and NN/NC
RH, satmax, activation temp/fraction, raw and capped NC_ACT, raw and capped PC_ACT, floor/cap active flags, post-activation state
actual radius-helper arguments/return values, including the exact NC and density arguments

saved_evidence_pins.scope: paired short run; selected recorded activation branch is full fraction (activation_fraction=1) with CCN floor active; does not demonstrate partial activation or inactive floors
partial cloud-fraction evidence; no paired activation-fraction or two-density isolation
source-extracted local algebra fixtures, not whole-module paired partial-CF run

activation_source_equations.fact: For RH>1, temp=min(1, exp(log((RH-1)/satmax)*actk)); NC_ACT=max(0,((NN+NC)*temp-NC))*rdtcld then min with max(NN,0)*rdtcld; PC_ACT is min of the embryo-mass expression and max(Q,0)*rdtcld. NN/NC/QC/Q updates follow at 2534-2538.
activation_source_equations.partial_activation_conditions: Require measured 0<temp<1 and NC_ACT>0; also record that the NN cap and vapor-mass cap are inactive, and that pre/post NN and NC do not hit ccnmin/ncmin. These are runtime predicates, not assumed from input intent.

ccn_initialization_and_density.fact: The option-37 driver first-timestep initialization writes QNN_CURR=ccn_conc at 928-931. The UDM call marks this preinitialized and declares DEN dry. UDM's default flags are different (initialize CCN true and input density dry false at 330-332), so fixture must confirm the actual option-37 path, not rely on defaults.
ccn_initialization_and_density.scope_limit: This only identifies the configured branch/source assignments; it does not authenticate all restart, boundary, advection, or producer paths.

cloud_fraction_timing.fact: UDM calls cldf_diag, copies cldf to udm_cldfra, and records timestep/top at lines 1094-1098. It then divides condensate mass arrays qci/qrs by cldf for in-cloud process calculations at 1100-1112, and multiplies them back by cldf at 1299-1311 before the activation block starts at 2512.
cloud_fraction_timing.interpretation: The captured CF is the preceding closure-stage fraction. Activation sees restored grid-mean condensate arrays, not the transient in-cloud qci values. Do not label the activation qc as still in-cloud or claim every UDM process uses in-cloud mass.

inactive_controls.recommendation: At the selected partial-CF/partial-activation call record explicit branch booleans and pre/post values for the NN activation cap, PC_ACT vapor cap, ccnmin/ncmin floors, and any number repair/floor path preceding activation. Choose states with margins from these thresholds and verify them in the actual module output; do not claim them inactive solely because requested inputs were chosen that way.

mass_basis_activation_sees.fact: The activation block consumes the current q(k,i), qci(k,i,1), and ncr(k,i,1:2) arrays after the CF restoration loop. This invocation receives qv_curr/qc_curr/qnn_curr/qnc_curr and rho through the option-37 driver call; that call explicitly sets ccn_preinitialized=.true. and input_density_is_dry=.true. at 2894-2895.
mass_basis_activation_sees.scope_limit: The equations show no extra CF division at the activation site, and the passed condensate arrays have been restored to grid mean. The block uses its current NN/NC values directly; this source review does not independently establish the universal producer/storage population unit or convert it to #m^-3. Do not infer a density correction.

partial_cf_conditions.fact: cldf_diag thresholds at 3394-3450 zero cloud for qc+qi<1e-6; clamp CF to [0,1], map <0.01 to zero, >0.99 to one, and raise values from 0.01 to below 0.5 up to 0.5.
partial_cf_conditions.fixture_target: Select a real same-call state with 0.5 <= captured CF < 0.99; verify the observed value and exact timestep/column/level join. Do not assume that selecting subgrid inputs guarantees partial CF.

two_density_comparison.recommendation: Use two distinct but EOS-consistent tuples of p,T,qv and dry density from the same WRF dry-density authority, with all other held inputs and code fixed. Capture the exact same selected cell/level/call at UDM entry and the internal source-state needed to prove the selected density policy. Compare observer-reported activation intermediates/rates and radius-helper inputs/outputs. Treat the contrast as density sensitivity only; it cannot choose a density multiplier or establish physical Nc units without an independent population-basis authority.
